class GestureDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, data_dir, sample_dirs, max_seq_length=200):
        self.data_dir = data_dir
        self.samples = [
            d for d in sample_dirs if os.path.exists(os.path.join(data_dir, d))
        ]
        self.max_seq_length = max_seq_length
        self.name_to_id = {
            name: i + 1
            for i, name in enumerate(
                [
                    "vattene",
                    "vieniqui",
                    "perfetto",
                    "furbo",
                    "cheduepalle",
                    "chevuoi",
                    "daccordo",
                    "seipazzo",
                    "combinato",
                    "freganiente",
                    "ok",
                    "cosatifarei",
                    "basta",
                    "prendere",
                    "noncenepiu",
                    "fame",
                    "tantotempo",
                    "buonissimo",
                    "messidaccordo",
                    "sonostufo",
                ]
            )
        }

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.samples)

    @staticmethod
    def _get_features(video, max_seq_length=200):
        frames = video["Frames"]
        features = []
        prev_pos = None
        prev_distances = np.zeros(3)
        prev_angles = np.zeros(4)

        for i, frame in enumerate(frames):
            skeleton = frame["Skeleton"]
            positions = {}
            if isinstance(skeleton, np.ndarray):
                for joint in skeleton:
                    jtype = (
                        joint["JointsType"].item()
                        if isinstance(joint["JointsType"], np.ndarray)
                        else joint["JointsType"]
                    )
                    positions[jtype] = joint["WorldPosition"]

            hip_center = positions.get("HipCenter", np.zeros(3))
            joints = []
            for jtype in [
                "ShoulderLeft",
                "ShoulderRight",
                "ElbowLeft",
                "ElbowRight",
                "WristLeft",
                "WristRight",
                "HandLeft",
                "HandRight",
                "Head",
                "HipLeft",
                "HipRight",
                "KneeLeft",
                "KneeRight",
            ]:
                pos = positions.get(jtype, np.zeros(3)) - hip_center
                joints.extend(pos)

            # Velocity features
            if prev_pos is not None:
                velocity = np.array(joints) - prev_pos
            else:
                velocity = np.zeros_like(joints)
            prev_pos = np.array(joints)

            # Spatial relationship features
            hand_left = positions.get("HandLeft", np.zeros(3))
            hand_right = positions.get("HandRight", np.zeros(3))
            head = positions.get("Head", np.zeros(3))
            shoulder_left = positions.get("ShoulderLeft", np.zeros(3))
            elbow_left = positions.get("ElbowLeft", np.zeros(3))
            wrist_left = positions.get("WristLeft", np.zeros(3))
            shoulder_right = positions.get("ShoulderRight", np.zeros(3))
            elbow_right = positions.get("ElbowRight", np.zeros(3))
            wrist_right = positions.get("WristRight", np.zeros(3))

            # Calculate distances
            dist_hands = np.linalg.norm(hand_left - hand_right)
            dist_left_head = np.linalg.norm(hand_left - head)
            dist_right_head = np.linalg.norm(hand_right - head)

            # Calculate angles using vector math
            def calc_angle(a, b, c):
                ba = a - b
                bc = c - b
                cosine = np.dot(ba, bc) / (
                    np.linalg.norm(ba) * np.linalg.norm(bc) + 1e-6
                )
                return np.arccos(np.clip(cosine, -1, 1))

            angle_left_elbow = calc_angle(shoulder_left, elbow_left, wrist_left)
            angle_right_elbow = calc_angle(shoulder_right, elbow_right, wrist_right)
            angle_left_shoulder = calc_angle(hip_center, shoulder_left, elbow_left)
            angle_right_shoulder = calc_angle(hip_center, shoulder_right, elbow_right)

            # Combine all features
            spatial_features = np.array(
                [
                    dist_hands,
                    dist_left_head,
                    dist_right_head,
                    angle_left_elbow,
                    angle_right_elbow,
                    angle_left_shoulder,
                    angle_right_shoulder,
                ]
            )

            # Velocity of spatial features
            if i > 0:
                spatial_velocity = spatial_features - prev_distances
            else:
                spatial_velocity = np.zeros_like(spatial_features)
            prev_distances = spatial_features.copy()

            full_features = np.concatenate(
                [joints, velocity, spatial_features, spatial_velocity]
            )
            features.append(full_features)

        if len(features) == 0:
            return np.zeros((max_seq_length, 85))

        features = np.array(features[:max_seq_length])
        features = np.pad(
            features, ((0, max_seq_length - len(features)), (0, 0)), "constant"
        )
        return features

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        sample_dir = os.path.join(self.data_dir, self.samples[idx])
        mat_data = scipy.io.loadmat(
            os.path.join(sample_dir, f"{self.samples[idx]}_data.mat"),
            simplify_cells=True,
        )
        video = mat_data["Video"]
        features = self._get_features(video, self.max_seq_length)
        labels = [
            self.name_to_id[gest["Name"]]
            for gest in video.get("Labels", [])
            if gest["Name"] in self.name_to_id
        ]
        return (
            torch.FloatTensor(features),
            torch.LongTensor(labels),
            len(features[: self.max_seq_length]),
            len(labels),
        )


class GestureTransformer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self, input_size=85, d_model=512, nhead=8, num_layers=4, num_classes=21
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.embedding = nn.Linear(input_size, d_model)
        self.pos_encoder = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, 200, d_model))
        encoder_layers = TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model, nhead, dim_feedforward=1024, dropout=0.1
        )
        self.transformer = TransformerEncoder(encoder_layers, num_layers)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(d_model, num_classes)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.embedding(x) + self.pos_encoder[:, : x.size(1), :]
        x = x.permute(1, 0, 2)
        x = self.transformer(x)
        return torch.nn.functional.log_softmax(self.fc(x.permute(1, 0, 2)), dim=2)

    features, labels, input_lens, target_lens = zip(*batch)
    features_pad = pad_sequence(features, batch_first=True)
    labels_pad = pad_sequence([l for l in labels], batch_first=True, padding_value=0)
    return features_pad, labels_pad, torch.tensor(input_lens), torch.tensor(target_lens)

    return prev[-1]

class DepthCNN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.cnn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(1, 16, 5, padding=2),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(16, 32, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.MaxPool2d(2),
            nn.Conv2d(32, 64, 3, padding=1),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((4, 4)),
        )
        self.fc = nn.Linear(64 * 4 * 4, 64)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.cnn(x)
        return self.fc(x.view(x.size(0), -1))


def get_features(sample_dir):
    data_path = f"{sample_dir}/{os.path.basename(sample_dir)}_data.mat"
    data = loadmat(data_path)["Video"][0, 0]
    num_frames = data["NumFrames"][0, 0]
    sample_id = os.path.basename(sample_dir)

    features = []
    depth_cnn = DepthCNN().to(device).eval()
    prev_pos = {k: None for k in ["lh", "rh", "le", "re", "head"]}

    for frame_idx in range(1, num_frames + 1):
        frame_path = f"{sample_dir}/{sample_id}_{frame_idx}.mat"
        frame_data = loadmat(frame_path)

        # Process depth
        depth = torch.tensor(frame_data["Depth"], dtype=torch.float32)
        depth = depth.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0).to(device)
        depth_feat = depth_cnn(depth).squeeze().cpu().numpy()

        # Process skeleton
        skeleton = frame_data["Skeleton"]
        joints = {k: np.zeros(3) for k in prev_pos}
        if "JointsType" in skeleton.dtype.names:
            joint_types = skeleton["JointsType"][0]
            for i in range(len(joint_types)):
                jtype = joint_types[i][0]
                pos = skeleton["WorldPosition"][0][i][0]
                if jtype == "HandLeft":
                    joints["lh"] = pos
                elif jtype == "HandRight":
                    joints["rh"] = pos
                elif jtype == "ElbowLeft":
                    joints["le"] = pos
                elif jtype == "ElbowRight":
                    joints["re"] = pos
                elif jtype == "Head":
                    joints["head"] = pos

        velocities = {
            k: (joints[k] - prev_pos[k] if prev_pos[k] is not None else np.zeros(3))
            for k in joints
        }
        prev_pos = joints.copy()

        # Combine features
        dist_features = [
            np.linalg.norm(joints["lh"] - joints["head"]),
            np.linalg.norm(joints["rh"] - joints["head"]),
            np.linalg.norm(joints["lh"] - joints["rh"]),
        ]
        skeleton_feat = np.concatenate(
            [
                joints["lh"],
                joints["rh"],
                joints["le"],
                joints["re"],
                joints["head"],
                velocities["lh"],
                velocities["rh"],
                velocities["le"],
                velocities["re"],
                velocities["head"],
                dist_features,
            ]
        )
        combined = np.concatenate([skeleton_feat, depth_feat])
        features.append(combined)

    return np.array(features)

def levenshtein(s1, s2):
    if len(s1) < len(s2):
        return levenshtein(s2, s1)
    if len(s2) == 0:
        return len(s1)
    previous = range(len(s2) + 1)
    for i, c1 in enumerate(s1):
        current = [i + 1]
        for j, c2 in enumerate(s2):
            insert = previous[j + 1] + 1
            delete = current[j] + 1
            replace = previous[j] + (c1 != c2)
            current.append(min(insert, delete, replace))
        previous = current
    return previous[-1]

def get_joint_features(mat_path, depth_path):
    try:
        mat = loadmat(mat_path, simplify_cells=True)
        video = mat["Video"]
        frames = video["Frames"]
        num_frames = video["NumFrames"]
    except:
        return None

    depth_features = []
    prev_depth = None
    if depth_path and os.path.exists(depth_path):
        cap = cv2.VideoCapture(depth_path)
        while cap.isOpened():
            ret, frame = cap.read()
            if not ret:
                break
            if frame.ndim == 3:
                frame = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)

            if prev_depth is not None:
                diff = cv2.absdiff(frame, prev_depth)
                hist = cv2.calcHist([diff], [0], None, [DEPTH_BINS], [0, 256]).flatten()
                hist = hist / hist.sum() if hist.sum() > 0 else np.zeros(DEPTH_BINS)
                depth_features.append(hist)
            else:
                depth_features.append(np.zeros(DEPTH_BINS))
            prev_depth = frame
        cap.release()

    if len(depth_features) < num_frames:
        depth_features += [np.zeros(DEPTH_BINS)] * (num_frames - len(depth_features))
    else:
        depth_features = depth_features[:num_frames]

    features = []
    prev_lhand = np.zeros(3)
    prev_rhand = np.zeros(3)

    for i, frame in enumerate(frames):
        try:
            if "Skeleton" not in frame:
                skeleton_feat = np.zeros(6)
            else:
                skel = frame["Skeleton"]
                joints = [j.strip() for j in skel["JointsType"]]
                l_idx = next((i for i, j in enumerate(joints) if "HandLeft" in j), None)
                r_idx = next(
                    (i for i, j in enumerate(joints) if "HandRight" in j), None
                )
                curr_lhand = skel["WorldPosition"][l_idx] if l_idx else np.zeros(3)
                curr_rhand = skel["WorldPosition"][r_idx] if r_idx else np.zeros(3)
                velocity = np.concatenate(
                    [curr_lhand - prev_lhand, curr_rhand - prev_rhand]
                )
                skeleton_feat = np.concatenate([curr_lhand, curr_rhand, velocity])
                prev_lhand = curr_lhand.copy()
                prev_rhand = curr_rhand.copy()

            depth_feat = (
                depth_features[i] if i < len(depth_features) else np.zeros(DEPTH_BINS)
            )
            combined_feat = np.concatenate([skeleton_feat, depth_feat])
            features.append(combined_feat)
        except:
            features.append(np.zeros(6 + DEPTH_BINS))

    return np.nan_to_num(np.array(features))

class TemporalBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, dilation, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        padding = (kernel_size - 1) * dilation // 2  # Adjusted padding calculation
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(
            in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, padding=padding, dilation=dilation
        )
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(out_channels)
        self.relu1 = nn.ReLU()
        self.dropout1 = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(
            out_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, padding=padding, dilation=dilation
        )
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(out_channels)
        self.relu2 = nn.ReLU()
        self.dropout2 = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.downsample = (
            nn.Conv1d(in_channels, out_channels, 1)
            if in_channels != out_channels
            else None
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = x
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu1(out)
        out = self.dropout1(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        out = self.relu2(out)
        out = self.dropout2(out)
        if self.downsample is not None:
            residual = self.downsample(residual)
        return out + residual


class GestureTCN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_size, num_channels, kernel_size, dropout):
        super().__init__()
        layers = []
        num_levels = len(num_channels)
        for i in range(num_levels):
            dilation = 2**i
            in_ch = input_size if i == 0 else num_channels[i - 1]
            layers.append(
                TemporalBlock(in_ch, num_channels[i], kernel_size, dilation, dropout)
            )
        self.network = nn.Sequential(*layers)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(num_channels[-1], 20)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = x.permute(0, 2, 1)
        out = self.network(x)
        out = out.permute(0, 2, 1)
        return self.fc(out)


def train_model(model, train_loader):
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=LR, weight_decay=1e-4)
    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.OneCycleLR(
        optimizer, max_lr=LR, steps_per_epoch=len(train_loader), epochs=NUM_EPOCHS
    )

    for epoch in range(NUM_EPOCHS):
        model.train()
        for inputs, labels in train_loader:
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            outputs = model(inputs)
            loss = criterion(outputs.view(-1, 20), labels.view(-1))
            loss.backward()
            nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            optimizer.step()
            scheduler.step()


def predict_sequence(model, features):
    model.eval()
    seq_len = features.shape[0]
    predictions = []
    with torch.no_grad():
        inputs = torch.FloatTensor(features).unsqueeze(0)
        outputs = model(inputs)
        preds = outputs.argmax(dim=2).squeeze(0).numpy()
        predictions.extend(preds)
    return predictions


def collapse_sequence(predictions):
    sequence = []
    prev = None
    for p in predictions:
        current = p + 1
        if current != prev:
            sequence.append(current)
            prev = current
    return sequence if sequence else [1]

def get_skeleton_features(frames):
    features = []
    prev_pos = {k: None for k in ["lh", "rh", "le", "re", "head"]}

    for frame in frames:
        joints = {k: np.zeros(3) for k in prev_pos}
        if "JointsType" in frame.dtype.names:
            for i, jtype in enumerate(frame["JointsType"][0]):
                joint_type = jtype[0]
                pos = frame["WorldPosition"][0][i][0]
                if joint_type == "HandLeft":
                    joints["lh"] = pos
                elif joint_type == "HandRight":
                    joints["rh"] = pos
                elif joint_type == "ElbowLeft":
                    joints["le"] = pos
                elif joint_type == "ElbowRight":
                    joints["re"] = pos
                elif joint_type == "Head":
                    joints["head"] = pos

        velocities = {
            k: (joints[k] - prev_pos[k] if prev_pos[k] is not None else np.zeros(3))
            for k in joints
        }
        prev_pos = joints.copy()

        dist_features = [
            np.linalg.norm(joints["lh"] - joints["head"]),
            np.linalg.norm(joints["rh"] - joints["head"]),
            np.linalg.norm(joints["lh"] - joints["rh"]),
        ]

        skeleton_feat = np.concatenate(
            [
                joints["lh"],
                joints["rh"],
                joints["le"],
                joints["re"],
                joints["head"],
                velocities["lh"],
                velocities["rh"],
                velocities["le"],
                velocities["re"],
                velocities["head"],
                dist_features,
            ]
        )
        features.append(skeleton_feat)

    return np.array(features)

        "num_frames": data["NumFrames"],
    }

class GestureModel(nn.Module):

def extract_tar_gz(tar_path, extract_dir):

            sample_extract_dir = os.path.join(extract_dir, sample_name)
            os.makedirs(sample_extract_dir, exist_ok=True)
            with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, "r") as z:

class GestureDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, data_dir, sample_dirs, max_seq_length=200):
        self.data_dir = data_dir
        self.samples = [
            d for d in sample_dirs if os.path.exists(os.path.join(data_dir, d))
        ]
        self.max_seq_length = max_seq_length
        self.name_to_id = {
            name: i + 1
            for i, name in enumerate(
                [
                    "vattene",
                    "vieniqui",
                    "perfetto",
                    "furbo",
                    "cheduepalle",
                    "chevuoi",
                    "daccordo",
                    "seipazzo",
                    "combinato",
                    "freganiente",
                    "ok",
                    "cosatifarei",
                    "basta",
                    "prendere",
                    "noncenepiu",
                    "fame",
                    "tantotempo",
                    "buonissimo",
                    "messidaccordo",
                    "sonostufo",
                ]
            )
        }

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.samples)

    @staticmethod
    def _get_features(video, max_seq_length=200):
        frames = video["Frames"]
        features = []
        prev_pos = None
        prev_distances = np.zeros(3)
        prev_angles = np.zeros(4)

        for i, frame in enumerate(frames):
            skeleton = frame["Skeleton"]
            positions = {}
            if isinstance(skeleton, np.ndarray):
                for joint in skeleton:
                    jtype = (
                        joint["JointsType"].item()
                        if isinstance(joint["JointsType"], np.ndarray)
                        else joint["JointsType"]
                    )
                    positions[jtype] = joint["WorldPosition"]

            hip_center = positions.get("HipCenter", np.zeros(3))
            joints = []
            for jtype in [
                "ShoulderLeft",
                "ShoulderRight",
                "ElbowLeft",
                "ElbowRight",
                "WristLeft",
                "WristRight",
                "HandLeft",
                "HandRight",
                "Head",
                "HipLeft",
                "HipRight",
                "KneeLeft",
                "KneeRight",
            ]:
                pos = positions.get(jtype, np.zeros(3)) - hip_center
                joints.extend(pos)

            velocity = (
                np.array(joints) - prev_pos
                if prev_pos is not None
                else np.zeros_like(joints)
            )
            prev_pos = np.array(joints)

            hand_left = positions.get("HandLeft", np.zeros(3))
            hand_right = positions.get("HandRight", np.zeros(3))
            head = positions.get("Head", np.zeros(3))

            dist_hands = np.linalg.norm(hand_left - hand_right)
            dist_left_head = np.linalg.norm(hand_left - head)
            dist_right_head = np.linalg.norm(hand_right - head)

            def calc_angle(a, b, c):
                ba = a - b
                bc = c - b
                cosine = np.dot(ba, bc) / (
                    np.linalg.norm(ba) * np.linalg.norm(bc) + 1e-6
                )
                return np.arccos(np.clip(cosine, -1, 1))

            angle_left_elbow = calc_angle(
                positions.get("ShoulderLeft", np.zeros(3)),
                positions.get("ElbowLeft", np.zeros(3)),
                positions.get("WristLeft", np.zeros(3)),
            )
            angle_right_elbow = calc_angle(
                positions.get("ShoulderRight", np.zeros(3)),
                positions.get("ElbowRight", np.zeros(3)),
                positions.get("WristRight", np.zeros(3)),
            )
            angle_left_shoulder = calc_angle(
                hip_center,
                positions.get("ShoulderLeft", np.zeros(3)),
                positions.get("ElbowLeft", np.zeros(3)),
            )
            angle_right_shoulder = calc_angle(
                hip_center,
                positions.get("ShoulderRight", np.zeros(3)),
                positions.get("ElbowRight", np.zeros(3)),
            )

            spatial_features = np.array(
                [
                    dist_hands,
                    dist_left_head,
                    dist_right_head,
                    angle_left_elbow,
                    angle_right_elbow,
                    angle_left_shoulder,
                    angle_right_shoulder,
                ]
            )
            spatial_velocity = (
                spatial_features - prev_distances
                if i > 0
                else np.zeros_like(spatial_features)
            )
            prev_distances = spatial_features.copy()

            full_features = np.concatenate(
                [joints, velocity, spatial_features, spatial_velocity]
            )
            features.append(full_features)

        if len(features) == 0:
            return np.zeros((max_seq_length, 92))

        features = np.array(features[:max_seq_length])
        features = np.pad(
            features, ((0, max_seq_length - len(features)), (0, 0)), "constant"
        )
        return features

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        sample_dir = os.path.join(self.data_dir, self.samples[idx])
        mat_data = scipy.io.loadmat(
            os.path.join(sample_dir, f"{self.samples[idx]}_data.mat"),
            simplify_cells=True,
        )
        video = mat_data["Video"]
        features = self._get_features(video, self.max_seq_length)
        labels = [
            self.name_to_id[gest["Name"]]
            for gest in video.get("Labels", [])
            if gest["Name"] in self.name_to_id
        ]
        return (
            torch.FloatTensor(features),
            torch.LongTensor(labels),
            len(features[: self.max_seq_length]),
            len(labels),
        )


class GestureTransformer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self, input_size=92, d_model=512, nhead=8, num_layers=4, num_classes=21
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.embedding = nn.Linear(input_size, d_model)
        self.pos_encoder = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, 200, d_model))
        encoder_layers = TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model, nhead, dim_feedforward=1024, dropout=0.1
        )
        self.transformer = TransformerEncoder(encoder_layers, num_layers)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(d_model, num_classes)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.embedding(x) + self.pos_encoder[:, : x.size(1), :]
        x = x.permute(1, 0, 2)
        x = self.transformer(x)
        return torch.nn.functional.log_softmax(self.fc(x.permute(1, 0, 2)), dim=2)


def collate_fn(batch):
    features, labels, input_lens, target_lens = zip(*batch)
    features_pad = pad_sequence(features, batch_first=True)
    labels_pad = pad_sequence([l for l in labels], batch_first=True, padding_value=0)
    return features_pad, labels_pad, torch.tensor(input_lens), torch.tensor(target_lens)

def levenshtein(s1, s2):
    if len(s1) < len(s2):
        return levenshtein(s2, s1)
    if not s2:
        return len(s1)
    prev = range(len(s2) + 1)
    for i, c1 in enumerate(s1):
        curr = [i + 1]
        for j, c2 in enumerate(s2):
            curr.append(min(prev[j + 1] + 1, curr[j] + 1, prev[j] + (c1 != c2)))
        prev = curr
    return prev[-1]

def get_skeleton_features(frames):
    features = []
    prev_pos = {k: np.zeros(3) for k in ["lh", "rh", "le", "re", "head"]}

    for frame in frames:
        joints = {k: np.zeros(3) for k in prev_pos}
        if "JointsType" in frame:
            for i, joint_type in enumerate(frame["JointsType"]):
                pos = frame["WorldPosition"][i]
                if joint_type == "HandLeft":
                    joints["lh"] = pos
                elif joint_type == "HandRight":
                    joints["rh"] = pos
                elif joint_type == "ElbowLeft":
                    joints["le"] = pos
                elif joint_type == "ElbowRight":
                    joints["re"] = pos
                elif joint_type == "Head":
                    joints["head"] = pos

        velocities = {k: (joints[k] - prev_pos[k]) for k in joints}
        prev_pos = joints.copy()

        dist_features = [
            np.linalg.norm(joints["lh"] - joints["head"]),
            np.linalg.norm(joints["rh"] - joints["head"]),
            np.linalg.norm(joints["lh"] - joints["rh"]),
        ]

        skeleton_feat = np.concatenate(
            [
                joints["lh"],
                joints["rh"],
                joints["le"],
                joints["re"],
                joints["head"],
                velocities["lh"],
                velocities["rh"],
                velocities["le"],
                velocities["re"],
                velocities["head"],
                dist_features,
            ]
        )
        features.append(skeleton_feat)

    return np.array(features)

def levenshtein(s1, s2):
    if len(s1) < len(s2):
        return levenshtein(s2, s1)
    if len(s2) == 0:
        return len(s1)
    previous = range(len(s2) + 1)
    for i, c1 in enumerate(s1):
        current = [i + 1]
        for j, c2 in enumerate(s2):
            insert = previous[j + 1] + 1
            delete = current[j] + 1
            replace = previous[j] + (c1 != c2)
            current.append(min(insert, delete, replace))
        previous = current
    return previous[-1]


def extract_archives():

def process_zip(zip_path):
    try:
        extract_dir = zip_path.replace(".zip", "")
        with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, "r") as z:
            z.extractall(extract_dir)
        data_file = depth_file = color_file = None
        for f in os.listdir(extract_dir):
            if f.endswith("_data.mat"):
                data_file = os.path.join(extract_dir, f)
            elif f.endswith("_depth.avi"):
                depth_file = os.path.join(extract_dir, f)
            elif f.endswith("_color.avi"):
                color_file = os.path.join(extract_dir, f)
        return data_file, depth_file, color_file
    except:
        return None, None, None


def get_joint_features(mat_path, depth_path, color_path):
    try:
        mat = loadmat(mat_path, simplify_cells=True)
        video = mat["Video"]
        frames = video["Frames"]
        num_frames = video["NumFrames"]
    except:
        return None

    # Depth processing
    depth_features = []
    prev_depth = None
    if depth_path and os.path.exists(depth_path):
        cap = cv2.VideoCapture(depth_path)
        while cap.isOpened():
            ret, frame = cap.read()
            if not ret:
                break
            if frame.ndim == 3:
                frame = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
            if prev_depth is not None:
                diff = cv2.absdiff(frame, prev_depth)
                hist = cv2.calcHist([diff], [0], None, [DEPTH_BINS], [0, 256]).flatten()
                hist = hist / hist.sum() if hist.sum() > 0 else np.zeros(DEPTH_BINS)
                depth_features.append(hist)
            else:
                depth_features.append(np.zeros(DEPTH_BINS))
            prev_depth = frame
        cap.release()
    depth_features = (depth_features + [np.zeros(DEPTH_BINS)] * num_frames)[:num_frames]

    # Optical flow processing
    flow_features = []
    if color_path and os.path.exists(color_path):
        cap = cv2.VideoCapture(color_path)
        ret, prev_frame = cap.read()
        if ret:
            prev_gray = cv2.cvtColor(prev_frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
            prev_gray = cv2.normalize(prev_gray, None, 0, 255, cv2.NORM_MINMAX)
            h, w = prev_gray.shape
            flow_features.append(np.zeros(FLOW_BINS))
            while True:
                ret, frame = cap.read()
                if not ret:
                    break
                gray = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
                gray = cv2.normalize(gray, None, 0, 255, cv2.NORM_MINMAX)
                flow = cv2.calcOpticalFlowFarneback(
                    prev_gray, gray, None, 0.5, 3, 15, 3, 5, 1.2, 0
                )
                mag, ang = cv2.cartToPolar(flow[..., 0], flow[..., 1])
                ang_deg = (ang * 180 / np.pi) % 360
                hist = np.histogram(
                    ang_deg, bins=FLOW_BINS, range=(0, 360), weights=mag
                )[0]
                hist = hist / (h * w)  # Normalize by pixel count
                flow_features.append(hist)
                prev_gray = gray.copy()
            cap.release()
        flow_features = (flow_features + [np.zeros(FLOW_BINS)] * num_frames)[
            :num_frames
        ]
    else:
        flow_features = [np.zeros(FLOW_BINS)] * num_frames

    # Skeleton processing
    features = []
    prev_lhand = prev_rhand = np.zeros(3)
    for i, frame in enumerate(frames):
        try:
            if "Skeleton" not in frame:
                skeleton_feat = np.zeros(6)
            else:
                skel = frame["Skeleton"]
                joints = [j.strip() for j in skel["JointsType"]]
                l_idx = next((i for i, j in enumerate(joints) if "HandLeft" in j), None)
                r_idx = next(
                    (i for i, j in enumerate(joints) if "HandRight" in j), None
                )
                curr_lhand = skel["WorldPosition"][l_idx] if l_idx else np.zeros(3)
                curr_rhand = skel["WorldPosition"][r_idx] if r_idx else np.zeros(3)
                velocity = np.concatenate(
                    [curr_lhand - prev_lhand, curr_rhand - prev_rhand]
                )
                skeleton_feat = np.concatenate([curr_lhand, curr_rhand, velocity])
                prev_lhand, prev_rhand = curr_lhand.copy(), curr_rhand.copy()

            combined = np.concatenate(
                [
                    skeleton_feat,
                    (
                        depth_features[i]
                        if i < len(depth_features)
                        else np.zeros(DEPTH_BINS)
                    ),
                    flow_features[i] if i < len(flow_features) else np.zeros(FLOW_BINS),
                ]
            )
            features.append(combined)
        except:
            features.append(np.zeros(6 + DEPTH_BINS + FLOW_BINS))

    return np.nan_to_num(np.array(features))


class GestureDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, samples, labels):
        self.samples = samples
        self.labels = labels

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.samples)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        return (
            torch.FloatTensor(self.samples[idx]),
            torch.LongTensor(self.labels[idx]),
        )


class TemporalBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, dilation, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        padding = (kernel_size - 1) * dilation // 2
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(
            in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, padding=padding, dilation=dilation
        )
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(out_channels)
        self.relu1 = nn.ReLU()
        self.dropout1 = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(
            out_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, padding=padding, dilation=dilation
        )
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(out_channels)
        self.relu2 = nn.ReLU()
        self.dropout2 = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.downsample = (
            nn.Conv1d(in_channels, out_channels, 1)
            if in_channels != out_channels
            else None
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = x
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu1(out)
        out = self.dropout1(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        out = self.relu2(out)
        out = self.dropout2(out)
        return out + (self.downsample(residual) if self.downsample else residual)


class GestureTCN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_size, num_channels, kernel_size, dropout):
        super().__init__()
        layers = []
        for i in range(len(num_channels)):
            dilation = 2**i
            in_ch = input_size if i == 0 else num_channels[i - 1]
            layers.append(
                TemporalBlock(in_ch, num_channels[i], kernel_size, dilation, dropout)
            )
        self.network = nn.Sequential(*layers)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(num_channels[-1], 20)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = x.permute(0, 2, 1)
        out = self.network(x)
        return self.fc(out.permute(0, 2, 1))


def train_model(model, train_loader):
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=LR, weight_decay=1e-4)
    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.OneCycleLR(
        optimizer, max_lr=LR, steps_per_epoch=len(train_loader), epochs=NUM_EPOCHS
    )

    for epoch in range(NUM_EPOCHS):
        model.train()
        for inputs, labels in train_loader:
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            outputs = model(inputs)
            loss = criterion(outputs.view(-1, 20), labels.view(-1))
            loss.backward()
            nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            optimizer.step()
            scheduler.step()


def predict_sequence(model, features):
    model.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        inputs = torch.FloatTensor(features).unsqueeze(0)
        outputs = model(inputs)
        return outputs.argmax(dim=2).squeeze(0).numpy()


def collapse_sequence(predictions):
    sequence = []
    prev = None
    for p in predictions:
        current = p + 1
        if current != prev:
            sequence.append(current)
            prev = current
    return sequence if sequence else [1]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    extract_archives()

    samples, labels, true_sequences = [], [], []
    for root, _, files in os.walk("working/train"):
        for file in files:
            if not file.endswith(".zip"):
                continue
            zip_path = os.path.join(root, file)
            mat_path, depth_path, color_path = process_zip(zip_path)
            if not mat_path:
                continue

            features = get_joint_features(mat_path, depth_path, color_path)
            if features is None or len(features) < SEQ_LEN // 2:
                continue

            try:
                mat = loadmat(mat_path, simplify_cells=True)
                video = mat["Video"]
                frame_labels = np.zeros(len(features), dtype=np.int64)
                true_seq = []
                for label in video.get("Labels", []):
                    name = label["Name"].strip()
                    if name in GESTURE_MAP:
                        gesture_id = GESTURE_MAP[name] - 1
                        true_seq.append(gesture_id + 1)
                        frame_labels[label["Begin"] : label["End"] + 1] = gesture_id

                for i in range(0, len(features) - SEQ_LEN + 1, SEQ_LEN // 2):
                    samples.append(features[i : i + SEQ_LEN])
                    labels.append(frame_labels[i : i + SEQ_LEN])

                if true_seq:
                    true_sequences.append((file.split(".")[0], true_seq))
            except:
                continue

    train_samples, val_samples, train_labels, val_labels = train_test_split(
        samples, labels, test_size=VAL_RATIO, random_state=42
    )
    _, val_sequences = train_test_split(
        true_sequences, test_size=VAL_RATIO, random_state=42
    )

    train_loader = DataLoader(
        GestureDataset(train_samples, train_labels),
        batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,
        shuffle=True,
        num_workers=4,
        pin_memory=True,
    )

    model = GestureTCN(
        input_size=6 + DEPTH_BINS + FLOW_BINS,
        num_channels=TCN_CHANNELS,
        kernel_size=KERNEL_SIZE,
        dropout=DROPOUT,
    )
    train_model(model, train_loader)

    total_lev = total_gestures = 0

        )

        )
        val_preds[sample_id] = pred_seq

    for sample_id, true_seq in val_sequences:

    score = total_lev / total_gestures if total_gestures else float("inf")
    print(f"Validation Score: {score}")

    submission = []
    test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
    for _, row in test_df.iterrows():
        sample_id = f"{row['Id']:04}"

        if not os.path.exists(zip_path):

        else:
            mat_path, depth_path, color_path = process_zip(zip_path)
            features = (
                get_joint_features(mat_path, depth_path, color_path)
                if mat_path
                else None
            )
            pred_sequence = (
                collapse_sequence(predict_sequence(model, features))
                if features is not None
                else [1]

class GestureDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, data_dir, sample_dirs, max_seq_length=200):
        self.data_dir = data_dir
        self.samples = [
            d for d in sample_dirs if os.path.exists(os.path.join(data_dir, d))
        ]
        self.max_seq_length = max_seq_length
        self.name_to_id = {
            name: i + 1
            for i, name in enumerate(
                [
                    "vattene",
                    "vieniqui",
                    "perfetto",
                    "furbo",
                    "cheduepalle",
                    "chevuoi",
                    "daccordo",
                    "seipazzo",
                    "combinato",
                    "freganiente",
                    "ok",
                    "cosatifarei",
                    "basta",
                    "prendere",
                    "noncenepiu",
                    "fame",
                    "tantotempo",
                    "buonissimo",
                    "messidaccordo",
                    "sonostufo",
                ]
            )
        }

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.samples)

    @staticmethod
    def _get_features(video, max_seq_length=200):
        frames = video["Frames"]
        features = []
        prev_pos = None
        prev_distances = np.zeros(3)
        prev_angles = np.zeros(4)

        for i, frame in enumerate(frames):
            skeleton = frame["Skeleton"]
            positions = {}
            if isinstance(skeleton, np.ndarray):
                for joint in skeleton:
                    jtype = (
                        joint["JointsType"].item()
                        if isinstance(joint["JointsType"], np.ndarray)
                        else joint["JointsType"]
                    )
                    positions[jtype] = joint["WorldPosition"]

            hip_center = positions.get("HipCenter", np.zeros(3))
            joints = []
            for jtype in [
                "ShoulderLeft",
                "ShoulderRight",
                "ElbowLeft",
                "ElbowRight",
                "WristLeft",
                "WristRight",
                "HandLeft",
                "HandRight",
                "Head",
                "HipLeft",
                "HipRight",
                "KneeLeft",
                "KneeRight",
            ]:
                pos = positions.get(jtype, np.zeros(3)) - hip_center
                joints.extend(pos)

            velocity = (
                np.array(joints) - prev_pos
                if prev_pos is not None
                else np.zeros_like(joints)
            )
            prev_pos = np.array(joints)

            hand_left = positions.get("HandLeft", np.zeros(3))
            hand_right = positions.get("HandRight", np.zeros(3))
            head = positions.get("Head", np.zeros(3))

            dist_hands = np.linalg.norm(hand_left - hand_right)
            dist_left_head = np.linalg.norm(hand_left - head)
            dist_right_head = np.linalg.norm(hand_right - head)

            def calc_angle(a, b, c):
                ba = a - b
                bc = c - b
                cosine = np.dot(ba, bc) / (
                    np.linalg.norm(ba) * np.linalg.norm(bc) + 1e-6
                )
                return np.arccos(np.clip(cosine, -1, 1))

            angle_left_elbow = calc_angle(
                positions.get("ShoulderLeft", np.zeros(3)),
                positions.get("ElbowLeft", np.zeros(3)),
                positions.get("WristLeft", np.zeros(3)),
            )
            angle_right_elbow = calc_angle(
                positions.get("ShoulderRight", np.zeros(3)),
                positions.get("ElbowRight", np.zeros(3)),
                positions.get("WristRight", np.zeros(3)),
            )
            angle_left_shoulder = calc_angle(
                hip_center,
                positions.get("ShoulderLeft", np.zeros(3)),
                positions.get("ElbowLeft", np.zeros(3)),
            )
            angle_right_shoulder = calc_angle(
                hip_center,
                positions.get("ShoulderRight", np.zeros(3)),
                positions.get("ElbowRight", np.zeros(3)),
            )

            spatial_features = np.array(
                [
                    dist_hands,
                    dist_left_head,
                    dist_right_head,
                    angle_left_elbow,
                    angle_right_elbow,
                    angle_left_shoulder,
                    angle_right_shoulder,
                ]
            )
            spatial_velocity = (
                spatial_features - prev_distances
                if i > 0
                else np.zeros_like(spatial_features)
            )
            prev_distances = spatial_features.copy()

            full_features = np.concatenate(
                [joints, velocity, spatial_features, spatial_velocity]
            )
            features.append(full_features)

        if len(features) == 0:
            return np.zeros((max_seq_length, 92))
        features = np.array(features[:max_seq_length])
        features = np.pad(
            features, ((0, max_seq_length - len(features)), (0, 0)), "constant"
        )
        return features

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        sample_dir = os.path.join(self.data_dir, self.samples[idx])
        mat_data = scipy.io.loadmat(
            os.path.join(sample_dir, f"{self.samples[idx]}_data.mat"),
            simplify_cells=True,
        )
        video = mat_data["Video"]
        features = self._get_features(video, self.max_seq_length)
        labels = [
            self.name_to_id[gest["Name"]]
            for gest in video.get("Labels", [])
            if gest["Name"] in self.name_to_id
        ]
        return (
            torch.FloatTensor(features),
            torch.LongTensor(labels),
            len(features[: self.max_seq_length]),
            len(labels),
        )


class GestureTransformer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self, input_size=92, d_model=512, nhead=8, num_layers=4, num_classes=21
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.embedding = nn.Linear(input_size, d_model)
        self.pos_encoder = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, 200, d_model))
        encoder_layers = TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model, nhead, dim_feedforward=1024, dropout=0.1
        )
        self.transformer = TransformerEncoder(encoder_layers, num_layers)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(d_model, num_classes)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.embedding(x) + self.pos_encoder[:, : x.size(1), :]
        x = x.permute(1, 0, 2)
        x = self.transformer(x)
        return torch.nn.functional.log_softmax(self.fc(x.permute(1, 0, 2)), dim=2)


def collate_fn(batch):
    features, labels, input_lens, target_lens = zip(*batch)
    features_pad = pad_sequence(features, batch_first=True)
    labels_pad = pad_sequence([l for l in labels], batch_first=True, padding_value=0)
    return features_pad, labels_pad, torch.tensor(input_lens), torch.tensor(target_lens)

def levenshtein(s1, s2):
    if len(s1) < len(s2):
        return levenshtein(s2, s1)
    if not s2:
        return len(s1)
    prev = range(len(s2) + 1)
    for i, c1 in enumerate(s1):
        curr = [i + 1]
        for j, c2 in enumerate(s2):
            curr.append(min(prev[j + 1] + 1, curr[j] + 1, prev[j] + (c1 != c2)))
        prev = curr
    return prev[-1]


def beam_search_decode(log_probs, beam_width=5):
    sequences = [[[], 0.0]]  # (sequence, score)
    for t in range(log_probs.size(0)):
        frame_probs = log_probs[t]
        candidates = []
        for seq, score in sequences:
            for c in range(frame_probs.size(0)):
                new_score = score + frame_probs[c].item()
                if c == 0:  # blank
                    candidates.append((seq.copy(), new_score))
                else:
                    new_seq = seq.copy()
                    if not new_seq or new_seq[-1] != c:
                        new_seq.append(c)
                    candidates.append((new_seq, new_score))
        candidates.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
        sequences = candidates[:beam_width]
    if not sequences:
        return []
    best_seq = sequences[0][0]
    merged = []
    prev = None
    for c in best_seq:
        if c != prev:
            merged.append(str(c))
            prev = c
    return merged

    target_lens = torch.tensor([len(t) for t in targets], dtype=torch.long)
    flat_targets = torch.cat([torch.tensor(t, dtype=torch.long) for t in targets])
    return padded_features, features_lens, flat_targets, target_lens

            char = log_probs[: lengths[i], i].argmax(-1)[t]
            if char != 0 and char != prev:
                seq.append(char.item())
                prev = char
        decoded.append(seq)
    return decoded

            insert = previous[j + 1] + 1
            delete = current[j] + 1
            replace = previous[j] + (c1 != c2)
            current.append(min(insert, delete, replace))
        previous = current
    return previous[-1]

def process_zip(zip_path):
    try:
        extract_dir = zip_path.replace(".zip", "")
        with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, "r") as z:
            z.extractall(extract_dir)
        data_file = depth_file = color_file = None

            if f.endswith("_data.mat"):
                data_file = os.path.join(extract_dir, f)

            elif f.endswith("_color.avi"):
                color_file = os.path.join(extract_dir, f)
        return data_file, depth_file, color_file
    except:
        return None, None, None


def get_joint_features(mat_path, depth_path, color_path):
    try:
        mat = loadmat(mat_path, simplify_cells=True)
        video = mat["Video"]
        frames = video["Frames"]
        num_frames = video["NumFrames"]
    except:
        return None

    depth_features = []
    prev_depth = None
    if depth_path and os.path.exists(depth_path):
        cap = cv2.VideoCapture(depth_path)
        while cap.isOpened():
            ret, frame = cap.read()
            if not ret:
                break
            if frame.ndim == 3:
                frame = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
            if prev_depth is not None:
                diff = cv2.absdiff(frame, prev_depth)
                hist = cv2.calcHist([diff], [0], None, [DEPTH_BINS], [0, 256]).flatten()
                hist = hist / hist.sum() if hist.sum() > 0 else np.zeros(DEPTH_BINS)
                depth_features.append(hist)
            else:
                depth_features.append(np.zeros(DEPTH_BINS))
            prev_depth = frame
        cap.release()
    depth_features = (depth_features + [np.zeros(DEPTH_BINS)] * num_frames)[:num_frames]

    flow_features = []
    if color_path and os.path.exists(color_path):
        cap = cv2.VideoCapture(color_path)
        ret, prev_frame = cap.read()
        if ret:
            prev_gray = cv2.cvtColor(prev_frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
            prev_gray = cv2.normalize(prev_gray, None, 0, 255, cv2.NORM_MINMAX)
            h, w = prev_gray.shape
            flow_features.append(np.zeros(FLOW_BINS))
            while True:
                ret, frame = cap.read()
                if not ret:
                    break
                gray = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
                gray = cv2.normalize(gray, None, 0, 255, cv2.NORM_MINMAX)
                flow = cv2.calcOpticalFlowFarneback(
                    prev_gray, gray, None, 0.5, 3, 15, 3, 5, 1.2, 0
                )
                mag, ang = cv2.cartToPolar(flow[..., 0], flow[..., 1])
                ang_deg = (ang * 180 / np.pi) % 360
                hist = np.histogram(
                    ang_deg, bins=FLOW_BINS, range=(0, 360), weights=mag
                )[0]
                hist = hist / (h * w)
                flow_features.append(hist)
                prev_gray = gray.copy()
            cap.release()
        flow_features = (flow_features + [np.zeros(FLOW_BINS)] * num_frames)[
            :num_frames
        ]
    else:
        flow_features = [np.zeros(FLOW_BINS)] * num_frames

    features = []
    prev_lhand = prev_rhand = np.zeros(3)
    for i, frame in enumerate(frames):
        try:
            if "Skeleton" not in frame:
                skeleton_feat = np.zeros(6)
            else:
                skel = frame["Skeleton"]
                joints = [j.strip() for j in skel["JointsType"]]
                l_idx = next((i for i, j in enumerate(joints) if "HandLeft" in j), None)
                r_idx = next(
                    (i for i, j in enumerate(joints) if "HandRight" in j), None
                )
                curr_lhand = skel["WorldPosition"][l_idx] if l_idx else np.zeros(3)
                curr_rhand = skel["WorldPosition"][r_idx] if r_idx else np.zeros(3)
                velocity = np.concatenate(
                    [curr_lhand - prev_lhand, curr_rhand - prev_rhand]
                )
                skeleton_feat = np.concatenate([curr_lhand, curr_rhand, velocity])
                prev_lhand, prev_rhand = curr_lhand.copy(), curr_rhand.copy()

            combined = np.concatenate(
                [
                    skeleton_feat,
                    (
                        depth_features[i]
                        if i < len(depth_features)
                        else np.zeros(DEPTH_BINS)
                    ),
                    flow_features[i] if i < len(flow_features) else np.zeros(FLOW_BINS),
                ]
            )
            features.append(combined)
        except:
            features.append(np.zeros(6 + DEPTH_BINS + FLOW_BINS))

    return np.nan_to_num(np.array(features))


class GestureDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, samples, labels):
        self.samples = samples
        self.labels = labels

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.samples)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        return (
            torch.FloatTensor(self.samples[idx]),
            torch.LongTensor(self.labels[idx]),
        )


class TemporalBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, dilation, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        padding = (kernel_size - 1) * dilation // 2
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(
            in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, padding=padding, dilation=dilation
        )
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(out_channels)
        self.relu1 = nn.ReLU()
        self.dropout1 = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(
            out_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, padding=padding, dilation=dilation
        )
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(out_channels)
        self.relu2 = nn.ReLU()
        self.dropout2 = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.downsample = (
            nn.Conv1d(in_channels, out_channels, 1)
            if in_channels != out_channels
            else None
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = x
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu1(out)
        out = self.dropout1(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        out = self.relu2(out)
        out = self.dropout2(out)
        return out + (self.downsample(residual) if self.downsample else residual)


class GestureTCN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_size, num_channels, kernel_size, dropout):
        super().__init__()
        layers = []
        for i in range(len(num_channels)):
            dilation = 2**i
            in_ch = input_size if i == 0 else num_channels[i - 1]
            layers.append(
                TemporalBlock(in_ch, num_channels[i], kernel_size, dilation, dropout)
            )
        self.network = nn.Sequential(*layers)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(num_channels[-1], 21)  # 20 gestures + non-gesture class

    def forward(self, x):
        x = x.permute(0, 2, 1)
        out = self.network(x)
        return self.fc(out.permute(0, 2, 1))


def train_model(model, train_loader):
    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=LR, weight_decay=1e-4)
    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.OneCycleLR(
        optimizer, max_lr=LR, steps_per_epoch=len(train_loader), epochs=NUM_EPOCHS
    )

    for epoch in range(NUM_EPOCHS):
        model.train()
        for inputs, labels in train_loader:
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            outputs = model(inputs)
            loss = criterion(outputs.view(-1, 21), labels.view(-1))
            loss.backward()
            nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            optimizer.step()
            scheduler.step()


def predict_sequence(model, features):
    model.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        inputs = torch.FloatTensor(features).unsqueeze(0)
        outputs = model(inputs)
        return outputs.argmax(dim=2).squeeze(0).numpy()


def collapse_sequence(predictions):
    sequence = []
    prev = None
    for p in predictions:
        current = p  # 0 is non-gesture, 1-20 are gestures
        if current == 0:
            continue
        if current != prev:
            sequence.append(current)
            prev = current
    return sequence if sequence else [1]

class GestureDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, data_dir, sample_dirs, max_seq_length=200):
        self.data_dir = data_dir
        self.samples = [
            d for d in sample_dirs if os.path.exists(os.path.join(data_dir, d))
        ]
        self.max_seq_length = max_seq_length
        self.name_to_id = {
            name: i + 1
            for i, name in enumerate(
                [
                    "vattene",
                    "vieniqui",
                    "perfetto",
                    "furbo",
                    "cheduepalle",
                    "chevuoi",
                    "daccordo",
                    "seipazzo",
                    "combinato",
                    "freganiente",
                    "ok",
                    "cosatifarei",
                    "basta",
                    "prendere",
                    "noncenepiu",
                    "fame",
                    "tantotempo",
                    "buonissimo",
                    "messidaccordo",
                    "sonostufo",
                ]
            )
        }

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.samples)

    @staticmethod
    def _get_features(video, max_seq_length=200):
        frames = video["Frames"]
        features = []
        prev_pos = None
        prev_distances = np.zeros(7)
        prev_angles = np.zeros(4)

        for i, frame in enumerate(frames):
            skeleton = frame["Skeleton"]
            positions = {}
            if isinstance(skeleton, np.ndarray):
                for joint in skeleton:
                    jtype = (
                        joint["JointsType"].item()
                        if isinstance(joint["JointsType"], np.ndarray)
                        else joint["JointsType"]
                    )
                    positions[jtype] = joint["WorldPosition"]

            hip_center = positions.get("HipCenter", np.zeros(3))
            joints = []
            abs_z = []
            for jtype in [
                "ShoulderLeft",
                "ShoulderRight",
                "ElbowLeft",
                "ElbowRight",
                "WristLeft",
                "WristRight",
                "HandLeft",
                "HandRight",
                "Head",
                "HipLeft",
                "HipRight",
                "KneeLeft",
                "KneeRight",
            ]:
                pos = positions.get(jtype, np.zeros(3)) - hip_center
                joints.extend(pos)
                if jtype != "HipCenter":
                    abs_z.append(positions.get(jtype, np.zeros(3))[2])

            velocity = (
                np.array(joints) - prev_pos
                if prev_pos is not None
                else np.zeros_like(joints)
            )
            prev_pos = np.array(joints)

            hand_left = positions.get("HandLeft", np.zeros(3))
            hand_right = positions.get("HandRight", np.zeros(3))
            head = positions.get("Head", np.zeros(3))

            dist_hands = np.linalg.norm(hand_left - hand_right)
            dist_left_head = np.linalg.norm(hand_left - head)
            dist_right_head = np.linalg.norm(hand_right - head)

            def calc_angle(a, b, c):
                ba = a - b
                bc = c - b
                cosine = np.dot(ba, bc) / (
                    np.linalg.norm(ba) * np.linalg.norm(bc) + 1e-6
                )
                return np.arccos(np.clip(cosine, -1, 1))

            angle_left_elbow = calc_angle(
                positions.get("ShoulderLeft", np.zeros(3)),
                positions.get("ElbowLeft", np.zeros(3)),
                positions.get("WristLeft", np.zeros(3)),
            )
            angle_right_elbow = calc_angle(
                positions.get("ShoulderRight", np.zeros(3)),
                positions.get("ElbowRight", np.zeros(3)),
                positions.get("WristRight", np.zeros(3)),
            )
            angle_left_shoulder = calc_angle(
                hip_center,
                positions.get("ShoulderLeft", np.zeros(3)),
                positions.get("ElbowLeft", np.zeros(3)),
            )
            angle_right_shoulder = calc_angle(
                hip_center,
                positions.get("ShoulderRight", np.zeros(3)),
                positions.get("ElbowRight", np.zeros(3)),
            )

            # Depth features
            hip_z = hip_center[2]
            mean_abs_z = np.mean(abs_z) if abs_z else 0.0
            std_abs_z = np.std(abs_z) if abs_z else 0.0
            min_abs_z = np.min(abs_z) if abs_z else 0.0
            max_abs_z = np.max(abs_z) if abs_z else 0.0

            spatial_features = np.array(
                [
                    dist_hands,
                    dist_left_head,
                    dist_right_head,
                    angle_left_elbow,
                    angle_right_elbow,
                    angle_left_shoulder,
                    angle_right_shoulder,
                    hip_z,
                    mean_abs_z,
                    std_abs_z,
                    min_abs_z,
                    max_abs_z,
                ]
            )
            spatial_velocity = (
                spatial_features - prev_distances
                if i > 0
                else np.zeros_like(spatial_features)
            )
            prev_distances = spatial_features.copy()

            full_features = np.concatenate(
                [joints, velocity, spatial_features, spatial_velocity]
            )
            features.append(full_features)

        if len(features) == 0:
            return np.zeros((max_seq_length, 102))
        features = np.array(features[:max_seq_length])
        features = np.pad(
            features, ((0, max_seq_length - len(features)), (0, 0)), "constant"
        )
        return features

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        sample_dir = os.path.join(self.data_dir, self.samples[idx])
        mat_data = scipy.io.loadmat(
            os.path.join(sample_dir, f"{self.samples[idx]}_data.mat"),
            simplify_cells=True,
        )
        video = mat_data["Video"]
        features = self._get_features(video, self.max_seq_length)
        labels = [
            self.name_to_id[gest["Name"]]
            for gest in video.get("Labels", [])
            if gest["Name"] in self.name_to_id
        ]
        return (
            torch.FloatTensor(features),
            torch.LongTensor(labels),
            len(features[: self.max_seq_length]),
            len(labels),
        )


class GestureTransformer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self, input_size=102, d_model=512, nhead=8, num_layers=4, num_classes=21
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.embedding = nn.Linear(input_size, d_model)
        self.pos_encoder = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, 200, d_model))
        encoder_layers = TransformerEncoderLayer(
            d_model, nhead, dim_feedforward=1024, dropout=0.1
        )
        self.transformer = TransformerEncoder(encoder_layers, num_layers)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(d_model, num_classes)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.embedding(x) + self.pos_encoder[:, : x.size(1), :]
        x = x.permute(1, 0, 2)
        x = self.transformer(x)
        return torch.nn.functional.log_softmax(self.fc(x.permute(1, 0, 2)), dim=2)


def collate_fn(batch):
    features, labels, input_lens, target_lens = zip(*batch)
    features_pad = pad_sequence(features, batch_first=True)
    labels_pad = pad_sequence([l for l in labels], batch_first=True, padding_value=0)
    return features_pad, labels_pad, torch.tensor(input_lens), torch.tensor(target_lens)

def levenshtein(s1, s2):
    if len(s1) < len(s2):
        return levenshtein(s2, s1)
    if not s2:
        return len(s1)
    prev = range(len(s2) + 1)
    for i, c1 in enumerate(s1):
        curr = [i + 1]
        for j, c2 in enumerate(s2):
            curr.append(min(prev[j + 1] + 1, curr[j] + 1, prev[j] + (c1 != c2)))
        prev = curr
    return prev[-1]


def beam_search_decode(log_probs, beam_width=5):
    sequences = [[[], 0.0]]
    for t in range(log_probs.size(0)):
        frame_probs = log_probs[t]
        candidates = []
        for seq, score in sequences:
            for c in range(frame_probs.size(0)):
                new_score = score + frame_probs[c].item()
                if c == 0:
                    candidates.append((seq.copy(), new_score))
                else:
                    new_seq = seq.copy()
                    if not new_seq or new_seq[-1] != c:
                        new_seq.append(c)
                    candidates.append((new_seq, new_score))
        candidates.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
        sequences = candidates[:beam_width]
    if not sequences:
        return []
    best_seq = sequences[0][0]
    merged = []
    prev = None
    for c in best_seq:
        if c != prev:

            nn.Conv1d(48, 64, kernel_size=3, padding=1), nn.ReLU(), nn.Dropout(0.2)
        )
        self.transformer = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(d_model=64, nhead=8, dim_feedforward=256),
            num_layers=4,
        )
        self.classifier = nn.Linear(64, 21)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = x.permute(0, 2, 1)
        x = self.conv(x)
        x = x.permute(2, 0, 1)
        x = self.transformer(x)
        return nn.functional.log_softmax(self.classifier(x), dim=-1)

    target_lens = torch.tensor([len(t) for t in targets], dtype=torch.long)
    flat_targets = torch.cat([torch.tensor(t, dtype=torch.long) for t in targets])
    return padded_features, features_lens, flat_targets, target_lens

            if char != 0 and char != prev:
                seq.append(char.item())
                prev = char
        decoded.append(seq)
    return decoded

# Bigram Language Model Implementation
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/training.csv")
bigram_counts = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(int))
start_token, end_token = "<s>", "</s>"

for seq in train_df["Sequence"]:
    gestures = list(map(int, seq.split()))
    if not gestures:
        continue
    # Add start and end transitions
    bigram_counts[start_token][gestures[0]] += 1
    bigram_counts[gestures[-1]][end_token] += 1
    # Add middle transitions
    for prev, curr in zip(gestures[:-1], gestures[1:]):
        bigram_counts[prev][curr] += 1

# Calculate probabilities with add-1 smoothing
vocab_size = 20
log_prob_matrix = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(float))

for prev in bigram_counts:
    total = sum(bigram_counts[prev].values()) + vocab_size
    for curr in range(1, 21) if isinstance(prev, int) else [end_token]:
        count = bigram_counts[prev].get(curr, 0) + 1
        log_prob_matrix[prev][curr] = np.log(count / total)
    # Handle end token probability
    if prev != start_token:
        count = bigram_counts[prev].get(end_token, 0) + 1
        log_prob_matrix[prev][end_token] = np.log(count / total)


def get_lm_score(prev_seq, candidate):
    if not prev_seq:
        return log_prob_matrix[start_token].get(candidate, -np.inf)
    last = prev_seq[-1]
    return log_prob_matrix[last].get(candidate, -np.inf)


# Modified Beam Search with Language Model
def beam_search_decode(log_probs, beam_width=5, lm_weight=0.5):
    sequences = [[[], 0.0, 0.0]]  # [sequence, model_score, lm_score]
    for t in range(log_probs.size(0)):
        frame_probs = log_probs[t]
        candidates = []
        for seq, model_score, lm_score in sequences:
            for c in range(1, 21):  # Skip blank (0) and use 1-20
                log_p = frame_probs[c].item()
                transition_score = get_lm_score(seq, c)
                new_model = model_score + log_p
                new_lm = lm_score + transition_score * lm_weight
                new_seq = seq.copy()
                if not new_seq or new_seq[-1] != c:
                    new_seq.append(c)
                candidates.append((new_seq, new_model, new_lm))
        # Select top candidates by combined score
        candidates.sort(key=lambda x: x[1] + x[2], reverse=True)
        sequences = candidates[:beam_width]

    if not sequences:
        return []
    # Find best sequence by combined score
    best_seq = max(sequences, key=lambda x: x[1] + x[2])[0]
    merged = []
    prev = None
    for c in best_seq:
        if c != prev:
            merged.append(str(c))
            prev = c
    return merged

def levenshtein(s1, s2):
    if len(s1) < len(s2):
        return levenshtein(s2, s1)
    if len(s2) == 0:
        return len(s1)
    previous = range(len(s2) + 1)
    for i, c1 in enumerate(s1):
        current = [i + 1]
        for j, c2 in enumerate(s2):
            insert = previous[j + 1] + 1
            delete = current[j] + 1
            replace = previous[j] + (c1 != c2)
            current.append(min(insert, delete, replace))
        previous = current
    return previous[-1]

def get_joint_features(mat_path, depth_path, color_path):
    try:
        mat = loadmat(mat_path, simplify_cells=True)
        video = mat["Video"]
        frames = video["Frames"]
        num_frames = video["NumFrames"]
    except:
        return None

    depth_features = []
    prev_depth = None
    if depth_path and os.path.exists(depth_path):
        cap = cv2.VideoCapture(depth_path)
        while cap.isOpened():
            ret, frame = cap.read()
            if not ret:
                break
            if frame.ndim == 3:
                frame = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
            if prev_depth is not None:
                diff = cv2.absdiff(frame, prev_depth)
                hist = cv2.calcHist([diff], [0], None, [DEPTH_BINS], [0, 256]).flatten()
                hist = hist / hist.sum() if hist.sum() > 0 else np.zeros(DEPTH_BINS)
                depth_features.append(hist)
            else:
                depth_features.append(np.zeros(DEPTH_BINS))
            prev_depth = frame
        cap.release()
    depth_features = (depth_features + [np.zeros(DEPTH_BINS)] * num_frames)[:num_frames]

    flow_features = []
    if color_path and os.path.exists(color_path):
        cap = cv2.VideoCapture(color_path)
        ret, prev_frame = cap.read()
        if ret:
            prev_gray = cv2.cvtColor(prev_frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
            prev_gray = cv2.normalize(prev_gray, None, 0, 255, cv2.NORM_MINMAX)
            h, w = prev_gray.shape
            flow_features.append(np.zeros(FLOW_BINS))
            while True:
                ret, frame = cap.read()
                if not ret:
                    break
                gray = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
                gray = cv2.normalize(gray, None, 0, 255, cv2.NORM_MINMAX)
                flow = cv2.calcOpticalFlowFarneback(
                    prev_gray, gray, None, 0.5, 3, 15, 3, 5, 1.2, 0
                )
                mag, ang = cv2.cartToPolar(flow[..., 0], flow[..., 1])
                ang_deg = (ang * 180 / np.pi) % 360
                hist = np.histogram(
                    ang_deg, bins=FLOW_BINS, range=(0, 360), weights=mag
                )[0]
                hist = hist / (h * w)
                flow_features.append(hist)
                prev_gray = gray.copy()
            cap.release()
        flow_features = (flow_features + [np.zeros(FLOW_BINS)] * num_frames)[

                curr_rhand = skel["WorldPosition"][r_idx] if r_idx else np.zeros(3)
                velocity = np.concatenate(
                    [curr_lhand - prev_lhand, curr_rhand - prev_rhand]
                )
                skeleton_feat = np.concatenate([curr_lhand, curr_rhand, velocity])
                prev_lhand, prev_rhand = curr_lhand.copy(), curr_rhand.copy()

            combined = np.concatenate(

                        else np.zeros(DEPTH_BINS)
                    ),
                    flow_features[i] if i < len(flow_features) else np.zeros(FLOW_BINS),
                ]
            )
            features.append(combined)
        except:
            features.append(np.zeros(6 + DEPTH_BINS + FLOW_BINS))

    return np.nan_to_num(np.array(features[:MAX_SEQ_LEN]))


class GestureDataset(Dataset):
    def __init__(self, samples, labels):
        self.samples = samples
        self.labels = labels

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.samples)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        return self.samples[idx], self.labels[idx]


def collate_fn(batch):
    features, labels = zip(*batch)
    lengths = [f.shape[0] for f in features]
    max_length = min(MAX_SEQ_LEN, max(lengths))
    padded_features = np.zeros((len(features), max_length, features[0].shape[1]))
    for i, f in enumerate(features):
        padded_features[i, : min(lengths[i], max_length)] = f[:max_length]

    target_lengths = [len(l) for l in labels]
    max_target_len = max(target_lengths)
    padded_labels = torch.full((len(labels), max_target_len), -100, dtype=torch.long)
    for i, l in enumerate(labels):
        padded_labels[i, : len(l)] = torch.LongTensor(l[:max_target_len])

    return (
        torch.FloatTensor(padded_features),
        padded_labels,
        torch.LongTensor([min(l, MAX_SEQ_LEN) for l in lengths]),
        torch.LongTensor(target_lengths),
    )


class TemporalBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, dilation, dropout=0.1):
        super().__init__()
        padding = (kernel_size - 1) * dilation // 2
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv1d(
            in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, padding=padding, dilation=dilation
        )
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm1d(out_channels)
        self.relu1 = nn.ReLU()
        self.dropout1 = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv1d(
            out_channels, out_channels, kernel_size, padding=padding, dilation=dilation
        )
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm1d(out_channels)
        self.relu2 = nn.ReLU()
        self.dropout2 = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.downsample = (
            nn.Conv1d(in_channels, out_channels, 1)
            if in_channels != out_channels
            else None
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        residual = x
        out = self.conv1(x)
        out = self.bn1(out)
        out = self.relu1(out)
        out = self.dropout1(out)
        out = self.conv2(out)
        out = self.bn2(out)
        out = self.relu2(out)
        out = self.dropout2(out)
        return out + (self.downsample(residual) if self.downsample else residual)


class GestureTCN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_size, num_channels, kernel_size, dropout):
        super().__init__()
        layers = []
        for i in range(len(num_channels)):
            dilation = 2**i
            in_ch = input_size if i == 0 else num_channels[i - 1]
            layers.append(
                TemporalBlock(in_ch, num_channels[i], kernel_size, dilation, dropout)
            )
        self.network = nn.Sequential(*layers)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(num_channels[-1], 21)  # 20 gestures + blank class
        self.log_softmax = nn.LogSoftmax(dim=-1)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = x.permute(0, 2, 1)
        out = self.network(x)
        out = out.permute(0, 2, 1)
        out = self.fc(out)
        out = self.log_softmax(out)
        return out.permute(1, 0, 2)


def train_model(model, train_loader):
    criterion = nn.CTCLoss(blank=0)
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=LR, weight_decay=1e-4)
    scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.OneCycleLR(
        optimizer, max_lr=LR, steps_per_epoch=len(train_loader), epochs=NUM_EPOCHS
    )

    for epoch in range(NUM_EPOCHS):
        model.train()
        for inputs, targets, input_lengths, target_lengths in train_loader:
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            outputs = model(inputs)
            loss = criterion(outputs, targets, input_lengths, target_lengths)
            loss.backward()
            nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
            optimizer.step()
            scheduler.step()


def predict_sequence(model, features):
    model.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        inputs = torch.FloatTensor(features[:MAX_SEQ_LEN]).unsqueeze(0)
        outputs = model(inputs)
        probs = torch.exp(outputs.permute(1, 0, 2))
        _, preds = torch.max(probs, dim=2)
        sequence = []
        prev = None
        for p in preds[0].tolist():
            if p != 0 and p != prev:
                sequence.append(p)
                prev = p
        return sequence if sequence else [1]

def extract_resnet_features(frame):
    with torch.no_grad():
        img_tensor = preprocess(cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)).unsqueeze(0)
        features = resnet(img_tensor).squeeze().numpy()
